answer: Admissions to LBRCE B.Tech are through AP EAPCET (College Code: 76, LBCE), plus management/NRI quota (Category B) seats. MBA admission is through AP ICET, and M.Tech through PGECET/GATE. After results, candidates go through counselling; for Category B seats, you can apply directly on lbrce.ac.in or contact the admissions office. Selected candidates must submit 10th & 12th mark sheets, entrance scorecard, transfer certificate, and ID proof at verification. Full steps are on the Admission Procedure page.

LBRCE offers 9 B.Tech programs: Aerospace Engineering (60 seats), AI & Data Science (180), Civil Engineering (60), Computer Science & Engineering (300), CSE - AI & ML (240), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (120), Electronics & Communication Engineering (240), Computer Science & IT (120), and Mechanical Engineering (60). Total UG intake is 1380 seats. Minors and Honors specializations are also available in several branches.
LBRCE offers M.Tech in Cyber Security, Electric Vehicle Technology, VLSI System Design, and Robotics and Automation (6 seats each), plus an MBA program with 120 seats. Total PG intake is 144 seats.

Fee structure varies by branch and admission category (convener/management/NRI quota) — reported 1st-year B.Tech fees generally range roughly ₹75,000 to ₹1,20,000 depending on branch and category, plus separate hostel and transport charges. The exact, current official figures are published on the Fee Structure page under Admissions on lbrce.ac.in.

LBRCE had 1117+ placements in AY 2025-26 (in progress) across branches, following 1174 in 2024-25 and 894 in 2023-24. Major recruiters include Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, HCL, Deloitte, LTIMindtree, KIA, KYB, and more, with 80+ recruiters visiting and a highest CTC of 25.5 LPA. Full branch-wise stats are on the Placements page.

LBRCE is located in Mylavaram, Krishna District, Andhra Pradesh. Phone: 7386349999, 9912030759, or 08659-222933/222934/223936/223937. Nearest bus station: PNBS Vijayawada (~46 km). Nearest railway station: Vijayawada Junction (~48 km). Nearest airport: Vijayawada International Airport (~70 km).
LBRCE provides separate hostel facilities with mess services for students. Hostel charges are additional to tuition fees. Full details are on the Hostels page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.

LBRCE offers management scholarships based on academic merit, sports, or special categories, in addition to AP government schemes like fee reimbursement for eligible students. Details are on the Scholarships page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.

The LBRCE Central Library is a large facility (over 21,000 sq ft) with a reading capacity of around 500 users, thousands of book volumes, and access to online journals and e-books. Details are on the Central Library page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE has 85 faculty members with a Ph.D. across departments. A full faculty directory (with names and designations) is available on the Faculty page under Quick Links on lbrce.ac.in.

LBRCE was founded in 1998 by Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy through the Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust. Current details for the Principal, Vice-Principal, Chairman, Vice-Chairman, President, and Governing Body are listed on the Administration section of lbrce.ac.in.

LBRCE was founded in 1998 by Sri Lakireddy Bali Reddy through the Lakireddy Bali Reddy Charitable Trust. Its vision is to empower students to become technologically vibrant, innovative, and emotionally matured, with a mission focused on academic excellence, holistic development, and industry partnerships.

LBRCE is an Autonomous institution, NAAC 'A' accredited, with several NBA-accredited programs. It's approved by AICTE, recognized by UGC, and affiliated with JNTU Kakinada. It has also ranked in NIRF and secured All India Rank 49 among 600+ colleges in the Internshala Annual Rankings 2025.

LBRCE has 75+ labs and research centers, including advanced labs like Dassault Systems Lab, MEMS Lab, LabVIEW Lab, Cisco Networking Lab, and an e-Yantra lab, plus 300+ research publications from faculty. The R&D section on lbrce.ac.in has more on ongoing research and funded projects.
LBRCE has facilities for Sports, a Yoga & Meditation Center, NCC, NSS, and various student clubs. Details are under the Student Corner section on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE provides college transportation for students. Route and timing details are on the Transport page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE has an on-campus Dispensary for student healthcare needs. Details are on the Dispensary page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE has an on-campus Bank facility for students and staff. Details are on the Bank page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE has an on-campus Cafeteria for students and staff. Details are on the Cafeteria page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE provides campus internet access for students. Details are on the Internet page under Student Corner on lbrce.ac.in.

The Examination Section handles exam notifications, timetables, results, revaluation, and certificate applications. General notices are posted on the Notifications, Examination Time Tables, and Academic Results pages under Exam. Section on lbrce.ac.in. For your individual results or timetable, please check the student ERP portal (erp.lbrce.ac.in) or contact the Exam Section directly, since these are specific to each student.

Academic calendars, lesson plans, and course structure & syllabus are published under the Academics section on lbrce.ac.in. Class/section timetables are published department-wise (updated each semester) — each department (CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, IT, AI&DS, CSM, ASE, MBA) has its own Timetables page linked from the main Academics > Timetables page, listing year and section-wise schedules as PDFs.
The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) oversees academic quality initiatives at LBRCE, including NIRF rankings. Details are on the IQAC section of lbrce.ac.in.
LBRCE has an active Alumni network. Details and registration are on the Alumni page on lbrce.ac.in.
Photos from campus events, functions, and activities are available on the Gallery page on lbrce.ac.in.
Current job openings and faculty/staff recruitment notices at LBRCE are posted on the Careers page under Quick Links on lbrce.ac.in.

LBRCE has a Grievance Redressal Committee, Internal Complaints Committee (ICC), Anti-Ragging Committee, and Discipline Committee to address student concerns. These are listed under the Committees section on lbrce.ac.in, with an online grievance form also available.
RTI Act information, Mandatory Disclosure documents, and Financial Audit Statements are published under Quick Links on lbrce.ac.in for transparency and compliance.
LBRCE publishes a College Brochure and a newsletter called 'Taurus'. Both are available under Quick Links on lbrce.ac.in.
